notes: Series-derivation DATA step from SAS2.sas: length Series $5, substr(left(Model),1,1) into SeriesCode, IF SeriesCode="A" then Series="A" else "Other". Jenner's sashelp.cars sample carries no Audi rows, so the source is read from a small work.cars built in autoexec with Audi models; the substr()/IF-THEN logic is unchanged. Added a trailing PROC PRINT so the derived Series is visible.
